paper_statement: On Poly-Poisson OOD, Geo-NeW reports 2.14e-2 versus Linear Attention at 4.60e-2 (53% reduction), and on NS2d-c++ OOD it reports 42.2e-2 versus Transolver at 91.40e-2 (54% reduction).
assumptions: Poly-Poisson trains on polygons with fewer than five sides and evaluates on more than five sides.
NS2d-c++ uses the paper's custom COMSOL/Gmsh geometry distributions and OOD split.
The Section 4.4 mean per-sample normalized L2 metric is used.
Both conjuncts are evaluated with faithful released models or training pipelines.

acceptance.verified: Both OOD conjuncts reproduce their absolute errors and named-baseline reductions under the exact custom splits.
acceptance.falsified: A faithful, adequately powered evaluation satisfying the paper assumptions contradicts one or both conjuncts.

required_inputs: Poly-Poisson ID/OOD processed data or complete generator/preprocessor
NS2d-c++ COMSOL/Gmsh ID/OOD data or complete generator/preprocessor
Geo-NeW and named-baseline checkpoints or complete training pipelines
rejection_rule: Reading Table 1, recomputing percentages, or using synthetic polygons/steps without the paper distributions is audit evidence only.
